description: Mapping of the 109 Caldwell objects to their NGC, IC and other catalogue designations, with common name, type, constellation and magnitude.
sources: targets/CATALOG.md  (local cross-check; sole source for NGC 2246 under C49)

field_notes.ngc / ic / other_designations: Designations Moore assigned to this entry; an empty list means the object has none in that catalogue.
field_notes.also_designated: Extra NGC/IC numbers covering the same physical object, not part of Moore's designation.
field_notes.primary_designation: First designation; null for C99 (Coalsack), which has none.
field_notes.distance_kly: Thousands of light years, per the Wikipedia table; null if unlisted.
field_notes.wikipedia_url: Article resolved via the MediaWiki API and verified to name the object; generated by scripts/fetch_caldwell_wikipedia_links.py.
